name: Noble
description: Born into wealth and privilege, you are used to power and influence.

name: Soldier
description: Trained in the art of war, you have experience in combat and discipline.

name: Outlander
description: Raised in the wild, you are skilled in survival and exploration.

name: Scholar
description: A life of study and knowledge has made you wise and intelligent.

name: Criminal
description: You have lived outside the law, relying on stealth and cunning.

name: Acolyte
description: You have spent your life serving a deity and learning sacred rites.

name: Entertainer
description: A performer at heart, you thrive on captivating an audience.

name: Merchant
description: You understand trade, negotiation, and the value of gold.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in isolation, gaining unique insights about the world.

name: Hunter
description: You track and hunt creatures, relying on precision and patience.
